details: idlive-face-capture-web-development@78.8.1 describes itself as a package for getting IP location and metadata. Its preinstall hook runs `node index.js` on npm install and requests `https://realwbx.com/ip.php?ip=8.8.8.8` with the hardcoded Authorization value `a3b620ea8719eae2fa9b62726364bcc9`, which differs from the value in each of the account's other packages. The npm account conx3993 published it on 2026-10-15, one of 9 packages from that account between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-15 whose preinstall hook calls realwbx.com.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: Executed by the preinstall script of idlive-face-capture-web-development@78.8.1.
